Ready for Occupation – Summer 2026

Prospect Bay is limited collection of just three luxurious substantial 4 bedroom detached A-rated private residences set within a prestigious coastal enclave on Mount Prospect Avenue, Clontarf. . Designed by award-winning Tyler Owens Architects, these striking residences combine refined contemporary architecture with exceptional energy performance and panoramic views over Dublin Bay.
New‑build homes of this calibre in Clontarf are exceptionally rare. Each residence extends to approximately 230 sq. m / 2,475 sq. ft across four impeccably designed levels, offering generous proportions, refined detailing and exceptional natural light throughout. 

Commanding uninterrupted panoramic views across Dublin Bay, these architect‑designed homes by Tyler Owens Architects combine elegant contemporary architecture with outstanding energy efficiency. The development is discreetly positioned within a private setting, bordered by landscaped woodland, creating an atmosphere of seclusion while remaining moments from Clontarf’s renowned seafront amenities.

Exceptional Interior Specification

Bedrooms 
Four generously proportioned bedrooms providing bright, elegant retreats. Larger‑than‑average master bedrooms are en suite and feature digital TV connections. Contemporary wardrobes by Moons fitted to each home as per show house specification. 

Bathrooms 
Refined main bathrooms, en suites and guest WCs with elegant sanitary ware, modern fittings and generous floor‑to‑ceiling tiling to all areas. 

Living Accommodation 
Elegant living rooms, sunny balconies, expansive kitchen and dining spaces, additional living areas, guest WC, roof terrace and roof garden. 

Kitchens 
Bespoke kitchens by Moon Kitchens, complete with stone worktops and central island. 

Utility Room 
High‑quality fitted cabinetry with stone worktop, plumbed for washing machine and dryer. 

Interior Finishes
Ceiling heights ranging from 2.7m to 3.0m with double‑height vaulted hallways 
Primed internal doors with modern architraves and skirting 
Architectural balustrades throughout 
Hardwood staircase with bespoke joinery 
Bespoke media units to living areas and rooftop lounge 
Office / study / bedroom spaces 
Walk‑in wardrobes to master and second bedroom 
Wardrobes to third bedroom 
Broadband, data points and USB charging throughout 
Satin chrome ironmongery 
Painted in one neutral colour throughout 
Windows and Doors
- High-performance double-glazed Aluclad windows for energy efficiency and comfort
- Composite front door with multi-point locking system for enhanced security and durability

Smart, Sustainable, Secure
- Air-to-water Joule heat pump system for nearly zero energy building (nZEB) performance
- A-Rated BER with high levels of insulation and airtight design
- Smart home features, USB charging points, intercom entry system, and intelligent lighting
- High-speed internet, TV and data points throughout

Outdoor & Parking
- Landscaped private gardens and balconies with glazed balustrades
- Private woodland to the rear of the development extending over an acre
- Two allocated car parking spaces per home

Management Company: Owen Reilly Property Management
Guarantee: 10-Year Homebond Structural Warranty

Key Features 

Uninterrupted sea views across Dublin Bay 
Approximately 230 sq. m of bright, expansive, high‑quality living accommodation 
A2‑rated energy efficiency with smart home integration 
Bespoke kitchens, superior joinery and premium interior finishes throughout 
Spacious balconies and roof terraces with elevated coastal outlooks 
Private development with landscaped woodland to the rear 
Prime location adjacent to Clontarf promenade, parks, schools and local dining
